# Upgrading from an older release

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_behaviour_docs.py. Do not edit manually. -->

How the models 0.87.0 generates differ in behaviour from the models each recorded older release generates, with default options, for every test fixture and payload validation case of the repository. Each older release ran in an environment with the package versions of its release day; the models were compared by behaviour as on the [release pages](0.87.0.md). Each change is attributed to the recorded releases that made it.

| From | same | no-behaviour | crash-fix | behaviour-change | now-fails | both-fail | unsupported |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.86.0 | 15375 | 57 | 414 | 17 | 0 | 679 | 82 |
| 0.80.0 | 14405 | 80 | 740 | 616 | 68 | 633 | 82 |
| 0.70.0 | 13178 | 151 | 1089 | 1399 | 236 | 489 | 82 |
| 0.45.0 | 2249 | 5989 | 1214 | 2293 | 127 | 294 | 4458 |
| 0.25.9 | 256 | 2298 | 1180 | 2704 | 119 | 299 | 9768 |

- **same**: identical output
- **no-behaviour**: the output differs, the models behave the same
- **crash-fix**: the older release failed to generate, import or validate; the newer one works
- **behaviour-change**: the models behave differently (types, constraints, names, defaults, validation results)
- **now-fails**: the older release worked; the newer one fails on the input
- **both-fail**: both releases fail on the input
- **unsupported**: one of the releases does not have the output model type or an option the generation uses
